notes: Numerical thresholds are targets/estimates/scenarios. No assumption below is treated as proven customer or live-provider evidence.

capacity.statement: Founder can sustain approximately 30 hours/week for eight relative weeks (240 hours total).
capacity.label: operating_assumption_locked
capacity.lock_note: Owner judgment lock during P02; revise only via dated decision if calendar reality breaks it.
capacity.falsification_test: If sustained capacity is materially below ~30 h/week, cut scope per roadmap or extend calendar before P06 broad build.
capacity.evidence_required: Operating lock recorded in docs/decisions/001-scope.md and this file.

city_access.statement: New York City (Manhattan south of 59th + Brooklyn Williamsburg/Prospect Heights/Park Slope) is the first catchment; public operator density supports venue verification and recruitment attempts.
city_access.label: locked_decision
city_access.catchment: Manhattan south of 59th + Brooklyn Williamsburg/Prospect Heights/Park Slope
city_access.falsification_test: If live recruitment fails entirely after authorized outreach, or venue facts cannot be verified for a 20–30 catalog, change city and propagate.
city_access.evidence_required: docs/research/hosts-private.json screen (≥5 near-ICP). Live host commitments still missing.

assumptions.name: Qloo hackathon key and applicable terms
assumptions.statement: An approved Qloo hackathon (or equivalent) API key will be issued in time, and the actual terms permit the intended demo processing (entity search, place insights, candidate-filtered rankings) for the public demo path.
assumptions.label: assumption
assumptions.key_request: Official form submitted; confirmation page received. No key in Gmail yet.
assumptions.falsification_test: P03 live probe: authenticated entity lookup + candidate-restricted ranking on real IDs fails, is denied, or terms forbid required processing/display/persistence → narrow domain/city or stop Qloo-dependent concept; never fabricate live fixtures.
assumptions.evidence_required: Redacted capability matrix, applicable terms references, unanswered provider questions (P03).

assumptions.name: Local place and seed-type coverage
assumptions.statement: Qloo can resolve representative voluntary seed types and produce usable rankings over a bounded NYC venue slate that intersects a 20–30 venue checked catalog.
assumptions.label: assumption
assumptions.falsification_test: P03/P11/P12: missing/extra candidate IDs, silently ignored filters, or failure to meet pre-registered coverage gates on real queries → host-pool mode, revise gates openly with versioned policy, or fail the capability gate.
assumptions.evidence_required: Capability matrix and discovery/rank coverage reports with honest denominators.

assumptions.name: Willingness to pay
assumptions.statement: At least some qualified budget owners will take a meaningful commercial next step (dated nonbinding exact-offer intent or budget-approver commitment) for a bounded planning offer; pricing hypothesis e.g. $19/month organizer offer is experimental only.
assumptions.label: assumption
assumptions.falsification_test: After concrete offer presentation (P04/P28), zero budget-owner exact-offer or approver commitments and persistent rejection reasons that planning software is not valued → do not claim validated monetization; pivot offer/buyer or stop commercial thesis.
assumptions.evidence_required: Private nonbinding intent records with offer, price, usage cap, owner, start condition; no payment before commercial rights.

assumptions.name: Voluntary member intake completion
assumptions.statement: Opt-in group members will complete voluntary taste/constraint intake (or explicit skip) without researcher data entry at a rate that makes the workflow usable.
assumptions.label: assumption
assumptions.falsification_test: Concierge/pilot intake: high abandonment, refusal to share seeds, or hosts unwilling to ask guests → reduce questions before optimizing ranking; if signals remain unavailable, stop or change wedge.
assumptions.evidence_required: Submission/abandonment counts, consented notes, multi-session intake tests (P04/P10/P26).

assumptions.name: Free-tier runtime fit
assumptions.statement: The bounded Worker + D1 + static assets architecture can complete representative planning sessions within Cloudflare Free CPU/subrequest limits and proposed latency targets without a paid hosting upgrade.
assumptions.label: assumption
assumptions.falsification_test: P03 probe and P23 measurement: Free CPU/quota errors persist after reducing stage/input/catalog size → do not promise this architecture; choose a verified free alternative or stop the live release; never silently upgrade paid plan to force fit.
assumptions.evidence_required: Deployed CPU/latency/payload samples (P03) and runtime report (P23).

interview_pain.rule: ≥3 of 5 qualified interviews substantiate recurring planning/rework pain with recent example
interview_pain.label: target

pilot_commitments.rule: ≥3 operators commit real outing + voluntary inputs; ≥1 commercial next step (nonbinding exact-offer or budget approver)
pilot_commitments.label: target

qloo_capability.rule: Live entity lookup + candidate-restricted ranking under confirmed demo-processing rights, or explicit narrow/stop
qloo_capability.label: gate
